text:
jon: Quick sync for next week's social rollout. Plan: LinkedIn carousel (data + screenshots), X thread teaser, and two caption variants for A/B. Need art + final copy by EOD.
maya: I can design the carousel. Will need the dataset CSV and a one-line source note.
carlos: CSV is in /drive/benchmarks/2024_q1_export.csv. Source note: 'internal production benchmarks, Apr 2024'.
maya: great, I'll mock 5 cards: cover stat, methodology, chart, customer quote (anonymized), CTA. Will export PNGs @1200x1200. Alt text for cover: "Benchmark: latency vs cost across model variants".
jon: For LinkedIn copy, let's test two variants: A) product-forward: emphasize performance and ops savings; B) story-forward: mini-customer narrative. Drafts below. Please react.
jon: LI-A: "Performance + savings: Our production benchmark shows median latency improvements and 30% lower token unit cost across workloads. See the full methodology in the webinar. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=bench_carousel"
jon: LI-B: "How one platform engineer cut inference spend without sacrificing SLAs. We ran benchmarks and the results are in 1 join our webinar to get the checklist: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=bench_carousel"
sophia: Both look good. Suggest shortening B to avoid second-person 'you' on LI. Maybe: 'A platform engineer cut inference spend...'
carlos: For X, we should use a short thread of 5 tweets aligning to the carousel cards. Add utm_source=x_thread on the CTA link and include ?utm_medium=social. Also recommend adding the link as the last tweet only.
jon: Draft X-thread:
Tweet1: "Benchmarks that matter for product teams: lower cost, same quality."
Tweet2: "We measured median latency and per-token unit cost across representative prompts."
Tweet3: "Key wins: smarter KV caching + adaptive batching = fewer tokens and lower tail latency."
Tweet4: "Customer highlight: anonymized case where monthly inference spend dropped 40%."
Tweet5: "Join our webinar for the full playbook: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x_thread&utm_campaign=bench_carousel&utm_medium=social"
maya: I'll attach the carousel PNGs and the chart PNGs to the LI post. What about image sizes? We should do 1200x1200 for each card.
carlos: alt for chart card: 'line chart comparing per-token cost across models and sequence lengths'.
sophia: Scheduling ask: LI carousel Thu 9am PT, X thread Thu 10:30am PT, reminder X Wed 4pm PT. scheduling-bot can you queue?
scheduling-bot: queued -> Buffer. LI-carousel: 2024-04-11T16:00:00Z, X-thread: 2024-04-11T17:30:00Z, Reminder: 2024-04-10T23:00:00Z.
jon: Lead routing: attendees get CRM tag 'webinar-bench-apr' and source from utm params. Can ops confirm?
carlos: ops ok, will add rule to map utm_source to lead.source and tag.
maya: Creative question: should we include a 30s clip for the follow-up reply on X? would boost engagement.
sophia: yes. Plan: day-after webinar, post X-thread reply with 30s clip + link to recording. day+3: LI article recap + blog link to raise organic SEO.
jon: approvals: react :thumbsup: for copy variant A or B. If both, we'll A/B with 60/40 split. Need reactions by 3pm.
maya: uploading assets -> https://figma.com/file/launch789/export/carousel_5cards.zip
carlos: I'll patch the webinar URL in the scheduled copy to include the proper utm strings before publish.
sophia: I'll draft the follow-up DM copy for LI non-attendees and post it here for review.
jon: Thanks team 1 if no objections we'll finalize queue at 3:15pm and run A/B accordingly.
